effects: Pulls exactly `amt` of `asset` from the signer's wallet into PositionsManager (safeTransferFrom), which puts it into the asset's yield wrapper.
Credits `amt` to the signer's available collateral balance for `asset` in PositionsManager.
Settles any pending FT supply rewards and credits them to the signer's FT collateral balance (a small side effect in the signer's favour).
formats.shown: "Deposit 5 USDC": the token and the exact amount that leave the wallet as collateral.

effects: Debits `amt` from the signer's available collateral balance for `asset`.
Sends `amt` of `asset` to the signer, delivered by the yield wrapper's withdraw(amt, msg.sender).
Reverts if the signer's health factor ends up below the safe threshold.
Settles any pending FT supply rewards into the signer's FT collateral balance.
formats.shown: "Withdraw 2 USDC": the token and amount of collateral coming back to the wallet.

findings.title: withdraw: the yield wrapper code that delivers the tokens is not in the directory, so the amount received is unverified.
findings.evidence: PositionsManager.sol _withdrawTo -> _withdrawFromWrapper: IftYieldWrapper(wrapper).withdraw(amount, to). The wrapper source is not among the contracts provided.
findings.fix: Add the ftYieldWrapper source so the amount the signer receives can be checked.

effects: Mints debt shares to the signer for `amt` of `asset`. The debt is interest-bearing and owed by the signer.
Sends `amt` of `asset` to the signer from the yield wrapper.
Reverts if the signer's health factor ends up below the safe threshold.
formats.shown: "Borrow 1 USDC": the token and amount borrowed into the wallet. That this creates debt is implied by the word borrow.

findings.title: borrow: the yield wrapper code that delivers the borrowed tokens is not in the directory.
findings.evidence: PositionsManager.sol _borrowTo: _withdrawFromWrapper(c.ftYieldWrapper, amt, to). The wrapper source is not provided.

effects: Pulls up to `amt` of `asset` from the signer, capped at the full outstanding debt rounded up (`used`).
Burns the matching debt shares of the signer and so reduces the signer's debt in `asset`.
formats.shown: "Repay 2 USDC": the token and the most that can leave the wallet to pay down debt.

findings.title: repay: a repay-all sentinel (max uint) shows as a huge token amount instead of 'Full debt'.
findings.evidence: PositionsManager.sol _repay: `if (amt >= fullDebt) { sharesToBurn = userShares; }` and only `used` is pulled. The descriptor field `amt` tokenAmount has no threshold/message.
findings.fix: Add params threshold and message (for example 'Full debt') to the repay amount field.

formats.key: approveBorrow(address delegate, address asset, uint256 borrowAllowance_)
effects: An allowlisted engine `delegate` can then borrow up to that amount in the signer's name (borrowFlashAndDepositFor, engineBatch BORROW_TO_ENGINE). The debt goes on the signer's account and the borrowed tokens go to the delegate.
formats.shown: "Borrow OK 0x1111…" with fields for the delegate and an allowance of 10 USDC.

findings.title: approveBorrow: 'Borrow OK {delegate}' doesn't say the delegate can create debt in your name.
findings.evidence: descriptor interpolatedIntent "Borrow OK {delegate}" and intent "Approve borrowing". PositionsManager.sol engineBatch BORROW_TO_ENGINE: _consumeBorrowAllowance(a.from,...); _borrowTo(a.from, a.asset, a.amount, msg.sender), so the debt is on the signer and the funds go to the engine.
findings.fix: Use an intent like "Allow {delegate} to borrow up to {borrowAllowance_} against your account".

findings.title: approveBorrow: the interpolated intent leaves out the allowance amount and token.
findings.evidence: interpolatedIntent "Borrow OK {delegate}" omits {borrowAllowance_}. Case 4 shows the 10 USDC only in a field.

formats.key: approveEngine(address engine, address asset, uint256 debitAllowance)
effects: Sets (overwrites) engineDebitAllowance[signer][engine][asset] to `debitAllowance`. The maximum value means unlimited.

An allowlisted `engine` can then move up to that amount of the signer's deposited collateral to any account (engineTransferAvail), place holds on it, or withdraw it to itself via withdrawFlashAndRepayFor/withdrawFlashAndDepositFor.
formats.shown: "Engine OK 0x3333…" with fields for the engine and an allowance of 10 USDC.

findings.title: approveEngine: 'Engine OK {engine}' doesn't say the engine can move your deposited collateral to others.
findings.evidence: descriptor intent "Approve engine debit" and interpolatedIntent "Engine OK {engine}". PositionsManager.sol engineTransferAvail -> _consumeTransferAllowance(from,...) then collateral[from][asset].avail -= amt; collateral[to][asset].avail += amt.
findings.fix: Use an intent like "Allow {engine} to spend up to {debitAllowance} of your deposited collateral".

findings.title: approveEngine: the interpolated intent leaves out the allowance amount and token.
findings.evidence: interpolatedIntent "Engine OK {engine}" omits {debitAllowance}. Case 5 shows the 10 USDC only in a field.
